questions.stem: A particle contains 3 up, 6 down and 2 strange quarks (u = +2/3 e, d = s = -1/3 e). What is its charge in units of e?

options.misconception: Adds one extra unit of charge
Subtracts one extra unit of charge
Uses the wrong sign for the down and strange contributions

questions.explanation: Summing the fractional charges gives Q = (2 times 3 minus 6 minus 2)/3 = -0.67 e. Adding or subtracting a whole unit, or treating down and strange quarks as positive, each misuses the constituent quark charges.
questions.hint: Add the fractional quark charges of each constituent.
